### God's Resourcefulness
Author: Truth For Life
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/truth-for-life/truth-for-life-dec-5-2010-11642203.html
Passage: Zechariah 1:20
Points:
- The four destructive horns represent oppressive worldly powers attacking God's people from every side.
- God sovereignly provides craftsmen equipped to shatter these hostile forces at the right time.
- The Lord supplies a sufficient counter to every opposition, commissioning four workmen to confront the four horns.
- God prepares the exact instruments needed for the work—practical craftsmen rather than mere planners.
- Believers should never despair over the church's apparent weakness, trusting God to raise up defenders and secure victory.
